title: range-parser returns -1 when only some ranges are invalid
prompt: Our rangeParser(size, str) in index.js parses a Range header. If at least one of the requested ranges is satisfiable but another is not, for example 'bytes=0-499,1000-,500-999' on a 200 byte resource, it returns -1 (unsatisfiable) for the whole header. It should return only the valid ranges, and -1 only when every range is invalid. Please fix it.
